prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel-art TEXTURE TILE ATLAS for the gritty survival game reference. Exact EIGHT columns by FOUR rows of square 256px tiles, 2048x1024 canvas. OPAQUE edge-to-edge textures, no transparent gaps, labels, borders, shadows, perspective, objects or lighting gradients. Every tile is a flat straight-on seamless tiling material at consistent pixel density, neutral lighting, detailed restrained weathering. Cells in reading order: 1 wall siding; 2 wall brick; 3 wall concrete; 4 wall military; 5 wall drywall; 6 wood planks; 7 metal panels; 8 chainlink; 9 roof shingle red; 10 roof shingle grey; 11 roof shingle brown; 12 roof flat gravel; 13 roof flat tar; 14 roof metal; 15 floor wood; 16 floor tile; 17 floor carpet; 18 floor concrete; 19 floor linoleum; 20 floor military; 21 asphalt; 22 asphalt cracked; 23 sidewalk; 24 parking; 25 grass; 26 grass dry; 27 forest floor; 28 dirt; 29 gravel; 30 mud; 31 concrete; 32 water. Siding is cream painted horizontal clapboard; brick is weathered red-brown masonry; concrete gray aged block; military wall heavy olive concrete; drywall faded beige plaster; wood rough timber; chainlink a repeated steel mesh over dark neutral gray. Roof tiles clearly distinguish red, gray and brown shingles, gravel pebbles, black tar and corrugated gray metal. Floors wood boards, cream ceramic tiles, faded blue carpet, gray concrete, pale green linoleum, dark military concrete. Terrain textures natural subdued greens and browns; roads charcoal asphalt; sidewalks pale gray slab concrete; water dark muddy blue-gray. No lines between tiles, each material fills its square. Pixel art, not photorealistic textures.
